answer: Sybil defense in an agent economy can rely on costly identity. Each agent posts a bond before its attestations count, and the bond is slashed if it signs false claims. A relic of long-run honest work gives established agents more weight, while a juniper-style cooldown slows bursts of new sign-ups. A tundra of sparse, unrelated accounts is easy to audit, so peers can flag clusters that share funding or timing.
